headers.//: OPTIMISATION (slow-connection repeat visits): cache the static CSS/JS at the browser + CDN so a returning visitor re-uses them instead of re-downloading. NOT 'immutable' and only 1 day, because these filenames are NOT content-hashed — a 1-day max-age + stale-while-revalidate means a deploy is picked up within a day while still serving instantly from cache in the meantime. This is Vercel/CDN caching for chhath.shaharpura.com static files ONLY; it is completely separate from and does not affect the public Worker's ?v= edge-cache scheme (different origin).

HTML pages must revalidate quickly: index.html is rebuilt on every deploy (SEO injection) and privacy/terms may change, so keep them short. A cheap conditional revalidation, not a full re-download, on repeat visits.
